summary: Getting too close to an end gateway causes the game to crash
description: The bug Going too close to the end gateway will cause the game to crash! Stack trace 1.15 Pre-release 1 : [ crash-2019-11-21_23.27.56-client.txt] Description: Rendering Block Entity java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 16 out of bounds for length 16 at java.base jdk.internal.util.Preconditions.outOfBounds(Preconditions.java:64) at java.base jdk.internal.util.Preconditions.outOfBoundsCheckIndex(Preconditions.java:70) at java.base jdk.internal.util.Preconditions.checkIndex(Preconditions.java:248) at java.base java.util.Objects.checkIndex(Objects.java:372) at java.base java.util.ArrayList.get(ArrayList.java:458) at dsy.a(SourceFile:41) at dsx.a(SourceFile:30) at dsx.a(SourceFile:11) at dsk.a(SourceFile:106) at dsk.b(SourceFile:95) at dsk.a(SourceFile:127) at dsk.a(SourceFile:95) at dqm.a(SourceFile:1180) at dqi.a(SourceFile:719) at dqi.a(SourceFile:549) at dbj.d(SourceFile:941) at dbj.b(SourceFile:576) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:202)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition 1.15 Pre-release 1.
2. Create a new Creative mode world with default settings.
3. Use the `/tp` command to teleport to the End dimension: `/tp @s ~ ~ ~ ~ ~`.
4. Locate an end gateway structure, which consists of 12 blocks of bedrock.
5. Move closer to the end gateway until you are within a few blocks of it.
6. Observe that the game crashes when getting too close to the end gateway.
7. Take screenshots and gather the `debug` folder contents as described in the knowledge source for attaching with the report.
8. Note the coordinates where the crash occurred for further testing or analysis.
Observed Behavior:
When a player gets too close to an end gateway, the game crashes. This occurs specifically in version 1.15 Pre-release 1, as evidenced by the crash log from November 21, 2019, titled "crash-2019-11-21_23.27.56-client.txt." The error message indicates a rendering issue with a block entity and provides the stack trace: `java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 16 out of bounds for length 16`. This exception occurs within the Java base library, specifically in the `Preconditions` class where index bounds are checked. The crash happens when attempting to access an array element that is outside its valid range, triggering the `IndexOutOfBoundsException`.

To reproduce this issue, launch Minecraft version 1.15 Pre-release 1 and enter a world containing end gateways. Navigate to one of these structures in Creative mode for easier movement. Getting within close proximity to the end gateway will cause the game to crash with the aforementioned stack trace. This behavior is consistent and repeatable upon reloading the world, indicating that this is not an isolated incident but a persistent bug.

To assist developers in diagnosing and fixing this issue, it's recommended to gather additional diagnostic information such as screenshots highlighting the position of the end gateway before the crash, a ZIP archive of the `debug` folder from the `.minecraft` directory, and the relevant log files including `latest.log` and the specific crash report. This comprehensive set of data will provide valuable context for the developers to understand and address the root cause of this issue effectively.
Expected Behavior: When getting too close to an end gateway, the game should not crash. Instead, the player should be able to approach and interact with the end gateway normally without any issues or disruptions in gameplay. The expected behavior is for the game to remain stable and functional regardless of proximity to the end gateway.
